teaser: Five 2025 essays on Portuguese as code, a sovereign open-source cloud, regulation as graphs and Europe in GenAI, read again: two moved, one did not.
core_idea: Five essays in 2025 took the Portugal talks to Europe: language as the new programming and a need for Portuguese models, a fully open-source, API-compatible, federated sovereign cloud, regulation turned into semantic graphs, and six GenAI trends that play to Europe; a year and a half later Amália and graph work moved, the sovereign cloud did not, and the better route is portable code, a dumb server and keys you hold, so sovereignty is the ability to move.
